paragraphs.chinese:
这一集里，好几个大人都特别受不了自己被挤到一边，哪怕别人确实比自己更适合做那件事。

Luke 和 Manny 在同一支篮球队，教练非常糟糕，整场比赛都在冲孩子们吼，还直接骂他们蠢。Phil 先过去试着好好谈，Jay 却直接插进来，威胁说再听见他骂孩子，就拿鞋砸他脑袋。教练当场不干了，临走前把球队直接甩给 Jay，让他自己教。

Phil 以前是真的教过篮球，所以自然以为 Jay 会把球队交给自己。结果完全相反。Jay 自己当主教练，只给 Phil 一个助教的位置，然后开始让孩子们打得更凶。效果一塌糊涂。孩子们越来越混乱，甚至开始跟自己队友抢球，比分也越来越难看，可 Jay 就是不肯听 Phil 的建议。

Phil 最后终于说出自己真正不爽的地方。Jay 总喜欢在 Phil 正做一件事的时候突然接管，不只是篮球，之前家庭烧烤时煎牛排也是一样。Phil 想让 Jay 正面承认，有些事 Phil 就是比他强。

Jay 极不情愿，但最后还是让出了教练位置。Phil 设计了一个很简单的战术，专门想给 Manny 创造本赛季第一次投篮的机会。Manny 差一点投进。球队最后还是输了，可至少孩子们终于像一支球队，不再像一场小型暴动。

Claire 和 Gloria 遇到的是另一种“被挤到一边”。Claire 带 Alex 去逛街，Alex 一看到学校里的几个女生，就求妈妈赶紧走、去车里等。Claire 这才突然意识到，女儿已经进入“妈妈的存在本身就很丢人”的阶段。篮球场上，Gloria 又因为给 Manny 加油太大声，被其他孩子拿来起哄，Manny 最后也请求她下一场别来了。

两个妈妈后来一边帮忙照顾 Lily，一边互相吐槽孩子突然不想要自己陪。Claire 很快就报了仇。Alex 后来找她要钱跟朋友出去，Claire 钱照给，却故意当着所有人的面大声聊她“小胸部”以后要买训练内衣。Gloria 的方式更阴一点：她不停夸今天跟 Lily 玩得有多开心，Manny 听着听着就吃醋了，主动邀请她来看下一场比赛。

与此同时，Mitchell 还没找到工作，Cameron 则去做了一份兼职。两个人表面上都说很喜欢新安排。实际上 Mitchell 在家快疯了，而 Cameron 又特别想回到以前在家照顾 Lily 的生活。

Jay 把 Mitchell 介绍给一个很有钱的商人 Charlie Bingham。Charlie 想请 Mitchell 做环境相关的法律工作。到了 Charlie 家里，Mitchell 和 Cameron 终于互相说实话：Mitchell 想工作，Cameron 想回家带孩子。

两个人决定让 Mitchell 接下工作，然后一转身把自己锁在了车库里。为了开门，他们反复按错按钮，实际上启动的是门外车道上的旋转台，于是自己的车一次又一次撞上 Charlie 的 Ferrari。等两人终于看到外面的惨状，Mitchell 基本也没什么谈条件的空间了。他直接接受了这份工作。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is mostly about adults who hate being pushed aside, even when somebody else is better at the job.

Luke and Manny play on the same basketball team, and their coach is awful. He spends the game screaming at the kids and calling them stupid. Phil tries to talk to him calmly, but Jay jumps in, threatens to throw a shoe at his head, and the coach quits on the spot. Before leaving, he tells Jay to coach the team himself.

Phil has actually coached basketball before and expects Jay to hand the team over. Jay does the opposite. He makes himself head coach, gives Phil the assistant job, and tells the boys to play more aggressively. It goes badly. The kids get confused, start fighting their own teammates for the ball, and the score gets worse while Jay ignores Phil’s advice.

Phil finally tells Jay what’s bothering him. Jay keeps taking over whenever Phil is doing something, whether it’s coaching basketball or grilling steaks at a barbecue. Phil wants him to admit that there are some things Phil is simply better at.

Jay hates saying it, but eventually he gives Phil the team. Phil draws up one simple play to get Manny his first shot of the season. Manny almost makes it. They still lose, but at least the boys finally look like a team instead of a small riot.

Claire and Gloria are dealing with kids who suddenly want less of them. Claire takes Alex shopping, but when Alex sees girls from school, she begs Claire to leave and wait in the car. At the basketball game, Gloria cheers so loudly for Manny that the other boys make fun of him, and Manny asks her not to come next time.

Later the two mothers compare notes while babysitting Lily. Claire gets revenge when Alex asks for money to go out: she gives it to her, then loudly talks about her “little boobies” and buying a training bra in front of everyone. Gloria is subtler. She keeps talking about the wonderful day she had with Lily until Manny gets jealous and invites her to his next game.

Meanwhile, Mitchell is still out of work and Cameron has taken a part-time job. Both pretend they like the new arrangement. In private, Mitchell is losing his mind at home, while Cameron desperately wants his old life with Lily back.

Jay introduces Mitchell to Charlie Bingham, a wealthy businessman who offers him an environmental-law job. At Charlie’s house, Mitchell and Cameron finally admit what they actually want: Mitchell wants to work, and Cameron wants to stay home.

They agree Mitchell should take the job, then lock themselves in the garage. Trying to get out, they keep pressing the controls for Charlie’s driveway turntable and repeatedly smash their car into his Ferrari. When they finally see the damage, Mitchell doesn’t have much room left to negotiate. He takes the job.
